full_prompt_en: A square, highly detailed monochrome pencil-and-ink illustration shows a dark-coated man lifting one round lens before an elaborate circular design. The background resembles a wall of finely drawn panels, figures, and mechanical ornaments, pale enough to sit behind the darker central portrait. Near the upper center, a broad ring of repeated marks curves behind the man's head and gives the image a halo-like geometry. Smaller rectangles with tiny sketched scenes stack along the right edge and overlap the outer circle. The man stands in the foreground slightly left of center, shown from the chest upward. Short swept-back hair is rendered in many precise gray strokes, and the pale face is firmly shaded beneath the brow and around the nose. Small round dark glasses hide the eyes; one hand rises to the lens at the left side of the image as though adjusting it. The other arm falls into the close-cut dark coat, whose high collar and broad lapels form a compact black mass across the lower center. Fine white breaks in the coat expose seams and folded edges without weakening its silhouette. The expression is serious and inward-looking, and the head angles slightly downward. Thin drawn lines spread outward from the circular background, connecting small panels and fragmentary motifs across the light field. The medium alternates dense charcoal-like shading on the figure with delicate linework and open white paper behind it. Light seems broad and frontal, lifting the face and hand while the coat remains the deepest value; no hard cast shadow crosses the background. The overall composition is cerebral and enigmatic, setting a concentrated dark portrait against a much wider network of pale circular and rectangular detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节极其丰富的单色铅笔与墨线插画描绘一位身穿深色外套的男子，在复杂圆形图案前抬起一侧圆镜片。背景像一面由细线描出的分格、人物与机械装饰组成的墙，颜色足够浅，退在更暗的中央肖像后。靠近上部中央，一道由重复标记组成的宽圆环弯过男子头后，为画面提供近似光环的几何结构。右边缘堆叠着画有微小场景的矩形框，与外层圆环相互重叠。男子略偏左站在前景，以胸部以上取景。向后梳起的短发由许多准确的灰色线条画成，浅色脸庞在眉下和鼻旁有明确暗部。小小的深色圆眼镜遮住眼睛；一只手举到画面左侧的镜片旁，像是在调整它。另一只手臂沉入裁切很近的深色外套，高领和宽翻领在下方中央形成紧凑黑色体块。外套里的细小白色空隙显示接缝与折边，却没有削弱剪影。表情严肃而内省，头略微低垂。纤细线条从圆形背景向外散开，把浅色区域中的小框和片段图案连在一起。媒介在人物身上浓密的炭笔般阴影和背后轻盈线描及白纸留空之间交替。光显得宽泛而偏正面，提亮脸和手，外套仍占最深明度；背景上没有强硬投影。整体构图理性而神秘，以集中的深色肖像对照更宽广的浅色圆形与矩形细节网络。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome illustration combines finely controlled pencil-like shading with intricate ink contours and large open paper whites. Dense charcoal values gather in a compact focal mass, while paler diagrams, repeated circles, and small rectangular divisions spread into the background. Crosshatching and closely spaced strokes give curved volumes depth; thinner lines keep secondary details airy and precise. The palette is strictly black, cool gray, and off-white, with contrast arising from line density rather than color. Broad even light preserves the delicate background and lifts selected surfaces without theatrical cast shadows. The composition layers one strong near silhouette over a network of concentric and gridded forms, creating a balance of clarity and visual complexity. The overall effect is intellectual and slightly uncanny, with exacting draftsmanship providing the texture.
style_prompt_zh: 单色插画把控制精细的铅笔式阴影、繁密墨线轮廓和大片纸白留空结合起来。浓密炭色明度聚集成紧凑焦点体块，较浅的图解线、重复圆形与小矩形分隔向背景展开。交叉排线与紧密笔触赋予弯曲体积纵深；更细的线让次要细节保持轻盈准确。色域严格限制在黑、冷灰与灰白，对比来自线条密度，而非颜色。宽泛均匀的光保留细腻背景并提亮选定表面，没有戏剧性投影。构图让一块有力的近处剪影叠在同心圆和网格形体的网络上，在清晰和视觉复杂之间取得平衡。整体效果理性且略显奇异，一丝不苟的绘制提供了主要肌理。
theme_en: A dark-coated man lifting one round lens before a densely drawn circular design
theme_zh: 一位深色外套男子在繁密圆形纹样前抬起一侧圆镜片
name: Grant Morrison
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
